code:
(define square
  (lambda (n)
    (* n n)))

(define (square n) (* n n))  ; shorthand for exactly the same thing

(square 7)                   ; 49
description: You can read two forms of the same square function.

steps.description: lambda creates a function with parameter n and body (* n n). You bind that function value to square with define.
The shorthand definition puts square and its parameter together. You give it the same multiplication body.

steps.question: What does square return when n is 7?

steps.description: You see 49 in the output. Both definitions describe the same computation.

title: Naming a lambda
